<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="טבת_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916230_theRebbe_919" batchId="meluket-_D7_98_D7_91_D7_AA_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916230_theRebbe_919__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contains the header and date of the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">B”H.</t>
    <t s="1">Shabbos Parshas Shemos,</t>
    <t s="2">19 Teves,</t>
    <t s="3">5748*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the first interpretation of "Yashresh Yaakov" as referring to the future redemption, where the root of the soul will be revealed.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">“The coming ones shall take root (Yashresh) Yaakov etc.”¹,</t>
    <t s="1">and the Tzemach Tzedek brings in his maamar beginning with this phrase²</t>
    <t s="2">the interpretation of the Targum Yonasan on the verse, that this refers to the redemption.</t>
    <t s="3">For the translation of “the coming ones” (haba’im) is “they will be gathered from among their exiles and will return to their land”</t>
    <t s="4">[for “the coming ones” refers to the coming to the land that will be in the future redemption,</t>
    <t s="5">“and He will bring you”³</t>
    <t s="6">“Hashem your G-d to the land”⁴],</t>
    <t s="7">and then “Yashresh Yaakov” will be,</t>
    <t s="8">“there the house of Yaakov will be born.”</t>
    <t s="9">And he explains in the maamar,</t>
    <t s="10">that “taking root”</t>
    <t s="11">(Yashresh)</t>
    <t s="12">is concealment</t>
    <t s="13">(like the rooting of a tree,</t>
    <t s="14">for the roots of the tree that are in the ground are in concealment)</t>
    <t s="15">and “birth” is revelation</t>
    <t s="16">(for before birth, while it is in its mother’s womb,</t>
    <t s="17">it is in concealment,</t>
    <t s="18">and when it is born it comes into revelation),</t>
    <t s="19">and this is that the translation of “Yashresh” is “they will be born” (yisyalidon),</t>
    <t s="20">meaning,</t>
    <t s="21">that the root of the soul</t>
    <t s="22">(Yashresh Yaakov)</t>
    <t s="23">will be in revelation</t>
    <t s="24">(they will be born).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the second interpretation of "Yashresh Yaakov" as referring to the fulfillment of mitzvos, which draws down the root of the soul from above the chain of descent.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And he continues in the maamar⁵</t>
    <t s="1">with another interpretation of “Yashresh Yaakov,”</t>
    <t s="2">that this refers to the fulfillment of the mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="3">For just as rooting in its simple sense is specifically in the ground,</t>
    <t s="4">so too with the soul</t>
    <t s="5">(Yaakov),</t>
    <t s="6">the rooting is in the fulfillment of practical mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="7">And the connection between the two interpretations of “Yashresh Yaakov”⁶</t>
    <t s="8">(the revelation of the root of the soul and the fulfillment of mitzvos)</t>
    <t s="9">is,</t>
    <t s="10">that the revelation of the root of the soul that will be in the future is through the fulfillment of mitzvos now.</t>
    <t s="11">And the concept is⁷,</t>
    <t s="12">that in the root of the soul there are several levels.</t>
    <t s="13">And the primary root of the soul is as it is rooted in the light that is above the chain of descent (hishtalshelus),</t>
    <t s="14">and this light is drawn down through the fulfillment of mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="15">For the drawing down through the study of Torah is from the aspect of Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="16">the beginning of the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="17">and the drawing down of the light that is above the chain of descent</t>
    <t s="18">is through the deed of mitzvos⁸.</t>
    <t s="19">And this is what our sages, of blessed memory, said⁹</t>
    <t s="20">“Whoever’s deeds are greater than his wisdom etc. is like a tree whose branches are few and whose roots are many,”</t>
    <t s="21">for the drawing down of the root of the soul is through the deed of mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="22">And this is the connection of the two interpretations of “Yashresh Yaakov,”</t>
    <t s="23">that through the fulfillment of mitzvos now</t>
    <t s="24">(the second interpretation of “Yashresh Yaakov”)</t>
    <t s="25">the root of the soul is drawn down,</t>
    <t s="26">and the revelation of this drawing down will be in the future,</t>
    <t s="27">“there the house of Yaakov will be born” (yisyalidon),</t>
    <t s="28">that the root of the soul will shine in revelation</t>
    <t s="29">(the first interpretation of “Yashresh Yaakov”).</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
